VerifiedX Ships Vault Update Aimed at Stopping Hacked vBTC Transfers VerifiedX today released upgraded self-custodial recovery Vaults as part of its Mainnet 9.0.0 upgrade. Bitcoin holders using vBTC can set a delay before transfers from their vault become final, allowing them to recall mistaken or unauthorized transfers during that window and recover assets to an owner-designated self-custodial address. These protections are enforced on-chain by VerifiedX network consensus, without requiring a separate custodian. The upgrade also embeds Bitcoin light-client verification into VerifiedX’s validator software, enabling validators to independently verify Bitcoin block headers, proof of work and chain progression with 6 confirmation burial depth. — link

US Stocks and Crypto Plunge as Democratic Sweep Fuels AI Regulation Fears U.S. stocks and cryptocurrencies plunged amid concerns that Democrats' sweep of both chambers of Congress could lead to tighter regulation of the AI industry. Democrats are also planning to investigate Trump family business dealings, including crypto-related ventures. The Nasdaq Composite fell 5.10%, the S&P 500 dropped 3.43%, and the Dow Jones Industrial Average declined 2.41% in intraday trading. According to Binance market data, BTC fell 5.97% to $75,695.68, after hitting a low of $75,568, while ETH dropped 7.29% to $2,247.74, with a low of $2,236.78. CoinGlass data shows that $879.92 million in crypto positions were liquidated over the past four hours, including $818.90 million in longs and $61.02 million in shorts. Over the past 24 hours, total liquidations reached $1.03 billion, affecting 198,192 traders, with the largest single liquidation occurring on Binance's ETHUSDT pair at $10.94 million. — link

US Initial Jobless Claims Fall to 189,000, Matching Mid-July’s Near 57-Year Low Again Initial jobless claims in the US fell by 6,000 to 189,000 in the final week of October, below market expectations of 196,000 and down from a revised 195,000 in the previous week. The reading matched the 57-year low recorded in mid-July, pointing to continued labor market resilience despite mounting economic headwinds. — link
